preconditions.description: The length of the guessed string s is between 2 and 100 inclusive.
The number of input strings is exactly 2n-2, where n is the length of the guessed string.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= n - 1 for s in input_lines)
preconditions.description: Each input string has length between 1 and n-1 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(s.islower() and s.isalpha() for s in input_lines)
preconditions.description: Each input string consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(input_lines)) == len(input_lines) for _ in range(1, n))
preconditions.description: For each length from 1 to n-1, there are exactly two distinct strings of that length in the input.

postconditions.description: The output string has exactly 2n-2 characters.
The output string contains exactly n-1 'P's and n-1 'S's.

postconditions.expression: all(c in ('P', 'S') for c in output)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string is either 'P' or 'S'.

postconditions.expression: any(all((s[:i] == input_lines[j] and output[j] == 'P') or (s[-i:] == input_lines[j] and output[j] == 'S') for j in range(2 * n - 2)) for i in range(1, n) for s in possible_strings)
postconditions.description: There exists at least one string s of length n such that for each input string, if it is a prefix of s, the corresponding output character is 'P', and if it is a suffix of s, the corresponding output character is 'S'.
